verdicts.evidence: Node falls back to the default (utf8) for an unrecognised encoding string on Hash.update. Measured directly: sha256 digests are identical for "" and "utf8" on 6 inputs including accents, emoji and latin1-range bytes, and the whole probe/cycle/shim output is byte-identical; the positive control (utf8 vs latin1 on "é") does differ, so the measurement is not blind.
